description: Template prompts for skill sound generation by visual category
usage: Templates provide base prompts and modifiers for generating consistent skill sounds. Combine basePrompt with appropriate modifiers based on skill properties.

modifiers.mid_power: blazing flames, fiery burst, intense burning
